data.name: Austina
data.gender_notes: Austina is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Roman family name Austus, which means 'great, magnificent, or venerable'. In Christianity, it is associated with Saint Austina, a martyr who was beheaded for her faith. The name Austina carries the meaning “Majestic, Gentle” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Austina usually hope their child will grow to embody majestic, gentle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes strength and gentleness.
data.etymology: Austina belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Majestic, Gentle.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Austina total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_greek.name: Αουστίνη
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αουστίνη είναι παράγωγο του ονόματος Αυγουστος, που σημαίνει μεγάλος, σεβαστός. Η Αουστίνη είναι συνδυασμός της λέξης Αυγουστος με τη θηλυκή κατάληξη -ίνη, που σημαίνει τιμή, μεγάλη. Το όνομα Αουστίνη χρησιμοποιείται ως προσωνυμία για μια γυναίκα που σεβάζεται τη μεγαλοσύνη του Θεού.

in_latin.name: Austina
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Austina is derived from the Latin name Augustus, meaning great, magnificent. The suffix -ina is added to form a feminine name, signifying honored or revered. In Christian tradition, Austina represents a person who reveres the greatness of God.

in_english.name: Austina
in_english.long_meaning: The name Austina originates from the Latin name Augustus, meaning great, magnificent. The name Austina is a feminine form, signifying a person who is honored, revered, or majestic. In Christian tradition, Austina represents a person who embodies greatness, humility, and devotion to God. The name Austina has been used across various Christian cultures, symbolizing a strong and faithful individual.

The name Austina, thereby, represents the inner strength that every Christian seeks to cultivate and uphold.
